# This project's memory wiki

Stand-in for the page schema `wiki-init.sh` scaffolds. Every wikilink below is an illustration of
the syntax, not an edge: internal links are `[[exact-filename-without-extension]]`, source
citations are `[[2026-W28]]`, and the cross-project atlas is `[[atlas/<page>]]`. None of the three
can resolve by construction, and none of them is a finding.
